# Helvety

> The main Helvety website. Products and apps engineered and designed in Switzerland.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://helvety.com): Main landing page for Helvety
- [Privacy Policy](https://helvety.com/privacy): How Helvety handles user data under the current published policy
- [Terms of Service](https://helvety.com/terms): Terms governing use of Helvety services
- [Impressum](https://helvety.com/impressum): Legal information and company details

## Helvety Ecosystem
- [Helvety Store](https://helvety.com/store): Official catalog for Helvety products and package downloads (see store for current availability and pricing)
- [Helvety PDF](https://helvety.com/pdf): PDF toolkit that processes files locally in the browser for supported operations
- [Helvety Auth](https://helvety.com/auth): Centralized authentication service for all Helvety apps
- [Helvety Contacts](https://helvety.com/contacts): Contact management with client-side encryption for sensitive fields
- [Helvety Notes](https://helvety.com/notes): Notes management with client-side encryption for sensitive fields
- [Helvety Tasks](https://helvety.com/tasks): Task management with client-side encryption for sensitive fields

## Optional
- [GitHub](https://github.com/CasparRubin/helvety): Public monorepo for all Helvety applications (open source under MIT)
